department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: PhD applications for Fall 2027 are due December 15, 2026.

app_fee.value: The department's PhD fee is USD 25 (reduced from the engineering school's USD 75).
app_fee.quote: $25 PhD Application Fee for PhDs, $0 MSE Application Fee

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional for the PhD application.
gre_general.quote: GRE Scores – Optional for the MSE and PhD application.

english_waiver.value: A test is required unless your school's sole or primary language of instruction, writing and testing is English; the waiver is requested in the application and approved by Graduate Admissions.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL/IELTS scores – Required for international students unless your native language is English, you have graduated with a degree from a university in most English-speaking countries, or your school’s sole/primary language of instruction, writing, and testing is English.

supervisor.value: You need not choose an advisor before applying; naming faculty you want to work with is welcome.
supervisor.quote: No, but applicants are welcome to indicate which faculty members they would like to work with.

funding.value: PhD students are fully funded for the duration of the PhD in full-time residence.
funding.quote: PhD students are fully funded (tuition, health insurance, and stipend) for the duration of their PhD program while they are in a full-time, resident status.

entry_route.value: Apply directly to the PhD with or without a master's.
entry_route.quote: applicants interested in earning a PhD, regardless of whether they already hold a master’s degree, are encouraged to apply directly to the PhD program.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Engineering school application; fee waiver is requested inside the application.
